Stealing the Magic Orb from the Orcs

The Orc Seer keeps the Magic Orb on an altar located on one of the islands. The Seer's bodyguards are always on the island. Note: You can reach the islands only by means of the drawbridge. To lower the bridge you must possess the island Orcs' mechanism.

Objectives

Find the altar

Take the orb

Locations

Maps
The river and the islands

Authored rewards

PropertyValue
Experience160.0

These are the authored base rewards. Scripts, choices and game rules can change the final reward.
